sections.heading: Getting started
paragraphs: At the beginning of the week, Khaled met a new neighbor. They wanted to get to know each other, so they spoke slowly and clearly. Khaled said, “Hello! It is nice to meet you.” His friend replied, “How are you today?” Khaled said, “I am doing well, thank you.” His friend replied, “What is your name?” Khaled said, “My name is Khaled.” His friend replied, “May I ask your name?” Khaled said, “Where are you from?” His friend replied, “I am from Saudi Arabia.” Khaled said, “Do you live around here?” They paused for a moment to remember each expression.

sections.heading: A useful exchange
paragraphs: As they continued, they learned to explain what they needed. Khaled said, “I live in Riyadh.” His friend replied, “Is this your first visit?” Khaled said, “Yes, I am here for the first time.” His friend replied, “Welcome to our city.” Khaled said, “Thank you for the warm welcome.” His friend replied, “What do you do?” Khaled said, “I work in technology.” His friend replied, “That sounds interesting.” Khaled said, “Do you speak English?” They paused for a moment to remember each expression.

sections.heading: Making it clearer
paragraphs: They listened, asked questions, and tried the next useful expressions. Khaled said, “I am still learning English.” His friend replied, “Could you speak more slowly?” Khaled said, “Of course, no problem.” His friend replied, “Sorry, I did not catch that.” Khaled said, “Could you say it again?” His friend replied, “What does that word mean?” Khaled said, “Let me explain it simply.” His friend replied, “I understand now.” Khaled said, “It was lovely talking to you.” They paused for a moment to remember each expression.

sections.heading: Ending well
paragraphs: Before leaving, they finished the conversation warmly. Khaled said, “I enjoyed our conversation.” His friend replied, “Do you have any questions?” Khaled said, “Not right now, thank you.” His friend replied, “I hope we meet again.” Khaled said, “Have a wonderful day.” His friend replied, “Take care and see you soon.” Khaled said, “Goodbye, and thank you again.” They felt more confident after practising together.
